gizmo.title: Memory game
gizmo.description: Turn over cards to find pairs. Pair a term with its meaning so a match shows understanding, or use two matching texts or images.

configure.title: Title
configure.description: The prompt shown in the header, for example: Match the term to its job.

configure.title: Pairs
configure.description: Each pair is two cards that belong together, usually a term and its meaning. A side needs text, an image, or both.

properties.title: First card image description
properties.description: Alternative text for the image. Needed when the card has no text.

properties.title: Second card image description
properties.description: Alternative text for the image. Needed when the card has no text.

advanced.title: Accent color
advanced.description: Optional color for the header chip, the card backs and the button.
